title: System Architecture & Component Design Document
summary: project-management/design/01-system-architecture.md — layered architecture diagram, design principles with concrete rationale, component responsibility table, technology stack justification. Standalone, no external product references.
description:
Write project-management/design/01-system-architecture.md, the top-level document a reviewer reads first. Ground it in src/agent_memory_sdk's real module layout (models.py, types.py, repositories/, store.py, db/, adapters/) and ARCHITECTURE.md section 1, but write it self-contained — a reader must not need to have read ARCHITECTURE.md first.

Required: (1) purpose/scope, no external comparison; (2) Mermaid graph TD layered-architecture diagram (models -> repositories -> store -> adapters, db/ cross-cutting); (3) design principles with concrete technical rationale (normalized per-type tables because Db2's vector index needs a NOT NULL column per type; pluggable-protocol extensibility; synchronous-by-default; mandatory scope predicates); (4) component responsibility table, one row per module; (5) technology stack and why (Python 3.10+, Pydantic v2, Db2 LUW VECTOR type, hatchling).

Fully independent of every other SDD story — new file only.
